result.instructions: Tools for Builder Prime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show projects in progress and their customer names."; "Which sales meetings are scheduled this week?"; "Show the details of project 111.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Builder Prime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run builderprime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run builderprime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run builderprime_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. builderprime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: builderprime_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Read projects with projects.read. Pages start at 0, max100. Vendor defaults last-modified-since to one year ago and forbids older dates; this is not a complete all-history report. Response includes customer names available on projects.

tools.name: builderprime_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Read one project and its customer/status/value fields. Requires projects.read.

tools.name: builderprime_list_meetings
tools.title: List meetings
tools.description: Read meetings beginning in a required date range (epoch milliseconds). Requires meetings.read; page is zero-based, limit max100.

tools.name: builderprime_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: Read employees; requires employees.read. Pagination is zero-based, limit max100.

tools.name: builderprime_list_meeting_types
tools.title: List meeting types
tools.description: Read meeting-types; requires meetingtypes.read. Pagination is zero-based, limit max100.

tools.name: builderprime_get_meeting_type
tools.title: Get meeting type
tools.description: Read one meeting type; requires meetingtypes.read.

tools.name: builderprime_list_meeting_results
tools.title: List meeting results
tools.description: Read meeting-results; requires meetingresults.read. Pagination is zero-based, limit max100.

tools.name: builderprime_get_meeting_result
tools.title: Get meeting result
tools.description: Read one meeting result; requires meetingresults.read.

tools.name: builderprime_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Create a project attached to an existing client opportunity; projects.create required. Show the exact fields to the user before calling. Executes immediately, may trigger vendor workflows.

tools.name: builderprime_update_project
tools.title: Update project
tools.description: Modify only supplied project fields; projects.edit required. Status names must exactly match the account. Runs immediately; status changes may trigger workflows. No deletion/archiving.

tools.name: builderprime_create_meeting
tools.title: Create meeting
tools.description: Create a meeting for a client opportunity. meetings.create required. Confirm dates, timezone, attendee and type before calling; writes immediately and vendor notifications may occur.

tools.name: builderprime_update_meeting
tools.title: Update meeting
tools.description: Reschedule or edit meeting details; meetings.edit required. Runs immediately, no separate enforced approval. Blank location clears it. Read the existing meeting to check any unchanged start/end time before changing only one date.
